local_changes: Preserve the 02_OS icon hover fade at the end of stylesheet.css.
Honor GNOME enable-animations and clear active effects when motion is disabled or the session locks.
Restrict effects to normal, dialog and modal dialog windows.
Gate unmaximize effects with maximize-effect, and use actor.meta_window consistently.
Disconnect added handlers on disable and make overview cleanup repeatable.
Clear the depth buffer before painting the flat mesh to keep window content visible on virtual/offscreen rendering targets.
Remove upstream trailing whitespace from bundled JavaScript files.
Recheck active-hint on each border timer tick so turning the outline off keeps it hidden.
Escape user-selected floating-exception titles and classes, and match invalid persisted patterns literally.
Compare both entity slot and generation, and allocate a fresh id when a slot is recycled.
Drop a dead pop-launcher service on backend EOF so a later search can start a new one.
metadata.json lists shell-version 51 in addition to upstream master_noble versions 45-50.
